Class RandomRobot

ru.ashemchuk.model.snake.RobotSnake
ru.ashemchuk.model.snake.RandomRobot
public class RandomRobot extends RobotSnake
Robot snake that moves randomly. Each move, there is a 30% chance it will change direction to a random one.
